question: What chronology can safely be extracted from the separately printed 正統七年十二月日 line on GK02538 volume 4 p057b, and does it date the surviving copy itself?

source_object.provider: Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies, Seoul National University
source_object.title: 大統曆註

volume4_page_057b.next_scanned_leaves: 0004/058a and 0004/058b are blank in the acquired window

chronology_adjudication.type_event_postface_scope: 金鑌跋 directly concerns large-type recasting and start of printing with the newly cast type; it is not a Datong-calendar-content date.
chronology_adjudication.safe_conclusion: The reviewed terminal textual layer contains a direct 1442 internal date and therefore cannot represent a text state earlier than 1442. The surviving copy may have been impressed in 1442 or later; the exact impression year is not closed by this line alone.

comparative_controls.observation: The specialist reference identifies the Kim Bin postface as written in 1434 and explicitly says it concerns casting type rather than Datong-calendar content.
A separate Gabinja book preserves the same class of 1434 Kim Bin type-casting postface and then separately records 正統元年十一月日 印出.

unresolved_lineage_questions: What exact bibliographic/typographic evidence binds 正統七年十二月日 to an impression, reprint, collation, or other terminal event for the surviving GK02538 object?
Which securely pre-1578 witness carries the exact combined Sanming/Yueling Rainwater 後四日 and Dahan 十三後日 fingerprint?
Which historical instruction explicitly maps 冬至餘…已上為退 state thresholds to the displayed whole-ke schedule?
transmission_impact.interpretation: 12EF strengthens the chronology of the GK02538 terminal textual layer only. It adds no direct-copy edge, reverses no existing unchanged-table disproof, and contributes zero exact Sanming-parent vote.

next_gate: Seek copy/type/bibliographic evidence resolving the function of the printed 正統七年十二月日 line without assuming it means 印出.
Continue searching for a securely pre-1578 exact combined Rainwater/Dahan fingerprint witness.
Continue searching for an explicit threshold-to-whole-ke state-selection operator.
